data.name: MRPS17
data.description: Mitochondrial ribosomal protein S17, upregulated in lung adenocarcinoma where it activates PI3K-AKT-mTOR signalling.
data.description_beginner: A building block of the ribosomes inside mitochondria - the little machines that make proteins for the cell's power plants. It is present at unusually high levels in lung adenocarcinoma, where it switches on PI3K-AKT-mTOR growth signalling.
